priorityList: Cast Fire Breath at Empower level 1 to maximize the damage of Consume Flame.
Cast Pyre on 3 or more targets, switching to Disintegrate if the pack is 2 targets or less.
Cast Living Flame at least once between every Fire Breath cast to consume Leaping Flames.
Cast Eternity Surge when no other higher priority abilities are available.
Cast Fire Breath at Rank 1 to apply its Damage over Time effect for Engulf and Enkindle.
Use Engulf on targets affected by Fire Breath to trigger Consume Flame and maximize damage throughput.
Cast Eternity Surge at a Rank corresponding to the number of active targets.
Activate Dragonrage on cooldown to ensure maximum Essence Burst generation.
Spend Essence and Essence Burst procs on Pyre for primary AoE damage.
Use Azure Strike as your filler spell to generate Essence Burst procs when Essence is low.
Use Deep Breath as a high-damage burst cooldown or for repositioning.
